answer: Audit graders by EXCESS vote-agreement, not raw. Over a window build each grader's score vector on the seats they share; honest judges scatter disagreement like trees dotting a knoll, but a sybil ring's personas flock as one raven, agreeing far past the base rate that easy answers already yield. Flag any cluster whose mutual agreement, measured above the per-assignment expected rate fixed by the beacon, crosses the null threshold; mark it sable and void its grades. Subtracting the honest base rate spares genuine easy consensus, so only manufactured lockstep is slashed.
